title: Decoherence and entropy production due to quantum fluctuations of spacetime
summary: The intersection between quantum mechanics and gravitational physics has been providing challenging puzzles for decades. In this thesis, we study the dynamics of an open quantum system coupled with a bath of gravitons, the quanta of the gravitational field in the linear limit of general relativity. We focus on two main aspects. First, we analyze the decoherence induced by gravitons when we consider the open system to be described by both external and internal degrees of freedom.
